label: Lamassu-FMO system
definition: A Lamassu system in which an organism possesses a genome-encoded DefenseFinder Lamassu-FMO subtype locus represented by the Lamassu-FMO rule row requiring the Lamassu-Fam__LmuA_effector_FMO and Lamassu-Fam__LmuB_SMC_Cap4_nuclease_II profiles.
observations: Lamassu-FMO branch under Lamassu system; distinct from the broader Lamassu system, other Lamassu-Fam rule subtypes, individual LmuA, LmuB, or LmuC proteins, SMC-family ATPases, unresolved FMO effector expansion and substrate chemistry, LmuABC complexes, dsDNA-end binding, exact phage triggers, native host breadth, unresolved cell-death outputs, DefenseFinder HMM rows, and other phage-defense systems.
